title: God as Judge
definition: God as Judge means that He will judge all people with perfect righteousness, truth, and justice.
summary: God sees every deed, motive, injustice, and sin. His judgment is holy and unavoidable.
christFocus: The Father has appointed Christ as Judge, and salvation is found only in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God sees every deed, motive, injustice, and sin. His judgment is holy and unavoidable.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
